proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d ha
  have hd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a * y ^ 3 + b * y ^ 2 + c * y + d) (3 * a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c) x := by
    intro x
    have h3 := (hasDerivAt_pow 3 x).const_mul a
    have h2 := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).const_mul b
    have h1 := (hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul c
    exact (((h3.fun_add h2).fun_add h1).add_const d).congr_deriv (by norm_num; ring)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have h0 := hx.hasDerivAt_eq_zero (hd x)
    by_contra hneg
    have hsq : (3 * a * x + b) ^ 2 = b ^ 2 - 3 * a * c := by
      have : 3 * a * (3 * a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c) = 0 := by rw [h0]; ring
      nlinarith
    have hzero : 3 * a * x + b = 0 := by
      have : (3 * a * x + b) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by rw [hsq]; linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (3 * a * x + b)]
    have hb : b = -(3 * a * x) := by linarith
    have hcc : c = 3 * a * x ^ 2 := by
      rw [hb] at h0
      linarith
    have hdiff : ∀ y : ℝ, (a * y ^ 3 + b * y ^ 2 + c * y + d) - (a * x ^ 3 + b * x ^ 2 + c * x + d) = a * (y - x) ^ 3 := by
      intro y
      rw [hb, hcc]
      ring
    rcases hx with hmin | hmax
    · obtain ⟨e, he, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hmin
      have h1 := hball (y := x + e / 2) (by rw [Real.dist_eq]; rw [show x + e / 2 - x = e / 2 by ring, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith)
      have h2 := hball (y := x - e / 2) (by rw [Real.dist_eq]; rw [show x - e / 2 - x = -(e / 2) by ring, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith)
      have d1 := hdiff (x + e / 2)
      have d2 := hdiff (x - e / 2)
      simp only at h1 h2
      have n1 : 0 ≤ a * (e / 2) ^ 3 := by
        have : x + e / 2 - x = e / 2 := by ring
        rw [this] at d1; linarith
      have n2 : 0 ≤ -(a * (e / 2) ^ 3) := by
        have : a * (x - e / 2 - x) ^ 3 = -(a * (e / 2) ^ 3) := by ring
        rw [this] at d2; linarith
      have : a * (e / 2) ^ 3 = 0 := by linarith
      have hne : (e / 2) ^ 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      exact (mul_ne_zero ha hne) this
    · obtain ⟨e, he, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hmax
      have h1 := hball (y := x + e / 2) (by rw [Real.dist_eq]; rw [show x + e / 2 - x = e / 2 by ring, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith)
      have h2 := hball (y := x - e / 2) (by rw [Real.dist_eq]; rw [show x - e / 2 - x = -(e / 2) by ring, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith)
      have d1 := hdiff (x + e / 2)
      have d2 := hdiff (x - e / 2)
      simp only at h1 h2
      have n1 : a * (e / 2) ^ 3 ≤ 0 := by
        have : x + e / 2 - x = e / 2 := by ring
        rw [this] at d1; linarith
      have n2 : -(a * (e / 2) ^ 3) ≤ 0 := by
        have : a * (x - e / 2 - x) ^ 3 = -(a * (e / 2) ^ 3) := by ring
        rw [this] at d2; linarith
      have : a * (e / 2) ^ 3 = 0 := by linarith
      have hne : (e / 2) ^ 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      exact (mul_ne_zero ha hne) this
  · intro hD
    set s := Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 3 * a * c) with hs
    have hspos : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hD
    have hss : s ^ 2 = b ^ 2 - 3 * a * c := Real.sq_sqrt hD.le
    set x0 := (-b + s) / (3 * a) with hx0
    have h3a : 3 * a ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ha
    have h3x : 3 * a * x0 = -b + s := by rw [hx0]; field_simp
    have hdf : deriv (fun y : ℝ => a * y ^ 3 + b * y ^ 2 + c * y + d) = fun x => 3 * a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c := by
      ext x
      exact (hd x).deriv
    have hdd : deriv (fun x : ℝ => 3 * a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c) x0 = 6 * a * x0 + 2 * b := by
      have h2 := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x0).const_mul (3 * a)
      have h1 := (hasDerivAt_id' x0).const_mul (2 * b)
      have h' : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => 3 * a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c) (6 * a * x0 + 2 * b) x0 :=
        ((h2.fun_add h1).add_const c).congr_deriv (by norm_num; ring)
      exact h'.deriv
    refine ⟨x0, Or.inl ?_⟩
    apply isLocalMin_of_deriv_deriv_pos
    · rw [hdf, hdd]
      nlinarith
    · rw [hdf]
      have : 3 * a * (3 * a * x0 ^ 2 + 2 * b * x0 + c) = 0 := by
        have : 3 * a * (3 * a * x0 ^ 2 + 2 * b * x0 + c) = (3 * a * x0) ^ 2 + 2 * b * (3 * a * x0) + 3 * a * c := by ring
        rw [this, h3x]
        nlinarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left h3a
    · exact (hd x0).continuousAt
target_source: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ), a ≠ 0 → ((∃ x, IsLocalExtr (fun y : ℝ => a * y ^ 3 + b * y ^ 2 + c * y + d) x) ↔ 0 < b ^ 2 - 3 * a * c)
